NEVER touch /opt/nxeon (live prod) or other /opt/nxeon-* worktrees. `cd /opt/nxeon-agent-ia` first. node_modules is symlinked so `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` works; after any prisma/schema.prisma edit run `npx prisma generate` before tsc.

# TASK: Restructure the shared-hosting panel from "everything revolves around the primary domain" to "a NAMED Plan that contains switchable, isolated Websites."

## The problem
The hosting account IS its setup domain (`HostingAccount.primaryDomain`, usually a free subdomain like `testing.sites.nxeon.cloud`). The whole panel header + Overview revolve around that one domain, so multiple websites feel bolted on. We already have (from prior work) a `WebsitesPanel.tsx` + `listWebsites(accountId)` action that lists primary + subdomains + addons as first-class sites with per-site install/set-primary — BUILD ON THAT, don't rebuild it.

## Target structure
- **Plan = a named workspace** (resources: storage, DBs, email, sites, SFTP, backups). NOT a domain.
- **Websites = first-class, switchable, searchable.** Primary is just a badge.

## Build (this agent owns the IA/navigation + naming + Overview cleanup + Logs tab + credentials)
1. **Plan name.** Schema: add `HostingAccount.name String?` (nullable). Display name = `account.name` ?? a friendly default derived from the plan tier (e.g. `${plan.name} Hosting` → "Pro Hosting"); NEVER show the raw setup subdomain as the plan title. Add `renameHostingAccount(accountId, name)` action (ownership-guarded, trimmed, length-capped) and a rename control in the Settings tab. Auto-default on display (no checkout change needed).
2. **Header** (HostingClient.tsx / HostingTabs.tsx / app/dashboard/hosting/[id]/page.tsx): show the **plan name** as the title (with the plan tier + PHP badges), and add a **website switcher / search** control — a dropdown or command-style search that lists every website (from listWebsites) and jumps to it (deep-link into the Websites tab focused on that site, e.g. `?tab=websites&site=<id>`). The primary domain becomes a small badge, not the title.
3. **Overview cleanup:** REMOVE the "getting started / Install WordPress" card entirely. REMOVE the inline "WordPress install: done" log lines from Overview. Keep the plan-resource summary (storage/inodes/extra sites/databases, SFTP, App credentials) — this is the plan-wide overview the user still wants.
4. **App credentials de-dupe:** the App-credentials section currently lists EVERY completed install (so two WordPress installs on the same domain show as two identical-looking rows). Change it to show **one credential per website** (the latest install for that target site), each labeled with its website hostname. Look at `getHostingAppCredentials` in lib/actions-hosting.ts and the `AppCredentials`/Overview component; installs carry a target (primary/subdomain/addon) in the task payload (from prior multisite work) — group by resolved target hostname, keep the newest.
5. **New "Logs" tab:** add a Logs tab to HostingTabs that shows the full hosting task history (install/app/backup/etc.) with status + timestamps — this is where the "WordPress install: done" feed moves to. Reuse the existing task-feed read (listHostingTasks) or add a richer `listHostingTaskLog(accountId)`.
6. **Domains vs Websites:** make **Websites** the hub for managing sites; keep the **Domains** tab focused only on ADDING subdomains/addon domains + DNS help (remove the per-site management overlap so the two tabs don't duplicate). Wire the website switcher to Websites.

## Constraints
- Build ON the existing WebsitesPanel/listWebsites; keep per-site install + set-primary working.
- Preserve every ownership/security guard. Don't break other tabs (Files, Databases, Email, Cron, Backups, Settings).
- On-brand (navy/violet/cyan), matches existing hosting panels.
- Another agent is separately adding storage/plan-upgrade controls (Settings/Overview) and another is reworking the Email tab — DON'T edit EmailTab.tsx, and in Settings just leave room for an upgrade section (don't build the upgrade billing). Note any coupling in your report.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` must be clean for your changes.

## Deliverable
Commit to agent/ia (clear message). Do NOT push/promote. Report: schema change, new/changed actions, the new header+switcher+Logs tab, Overview cleanup, credentials de-dupe logic, how Domains vs Websites now divide, and every shared-file edit (prisma/schema.prisma, lib/actions-hosting.ts, HostingTabs.tsx, HostingClient.tsx, page.tsx) for clean integration.

content.text:
Committed to `agent/ia`. Here's the report.

## Summary

Restructured the shared-hosting panel so a **named Plan (workspace) contains switchable Websites**, instead of everything revolving around the setup subdomain. `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean; committed to `agent/ia` (not pushed).

## Schema change
`prisma/schema.prisma` — added `HostingAccount.name String?` (nullable plan/workspace display name). Ran `npx prisma generate` (writes to the shared symlinked client — see coupling note).

## New / changed actions (`lib/actions-hosting.ts`)
- **`renameHostingAccount(accountId, name)`** — ownership-guarded (owner-or-admin), trimmed, capped at 60 chars; blank clears the custom name. Revalidates the account + list paths.
- **`friendlyPlanName(planName)`** helper — friendly default title from the plan tier (avoids "Hosting Hosting" doubling).
- **`HostingAccountView`** gains `name` (raw, for the rename input) and `displayName` (resolved: `name ?? friendlyPlanName(plan.name)` — never the raw subdomain). `toView` populates both.
- **`getHostingAppCredentials`** rewritten to de-dupe: resolves each install task's `payload.target` (primary / subdomain:id / addon:id) to its website hostname, keeps only the **newest credential per site**, and returns a new `site` field so each row is labelled with its hostname.
- **`listHostingTaskLog(accountId)`** (new) — full task history (up to 100), ownership-guarded, **secret-free** (never returns `result`) and non-mutating (safe to poll, unlike `listHostingTasks` which clears one-time results). Excludes retired `INSTALL_DBTOOL`.

## Header + switcher + Logs tab
- **`app/dashboard/hosting/[id]/page.tsx`** — title is now `account.displayName` with `{plan} plan` + `PHP` badges; primary domain demoted to a small linked badge. Passes new `initialSite` (from `?site=`) to HostingTabs.
- **`HostingTabs.tsx`** — added a command-style **WebsiteSwitcher** (search over `listWebsites`) above the tab bar; picking a site deep-links to `?tab=websites&site=<id|primary>` and opens Websites focused. Added **Logs** tab (`LogsTab` using `listHostingTaskLog`, polls, status+timestamp rows). 
- **`WebsitesPanel.tsx`** — new `focusSite` prop; scrolls the matching card into view and flashes a brand highlight ring.

## Overview cleanup (`HostingTabs.tsx`)
Removed the getting-started/Install-WordPress card (`GettingStarted`) and the inline install-log feed (`TaskFeed`) entirely from Overview, plus the associated `tasks` state. Kept the plan-resource summary (storage/inodes/extra-sites/databases quota tiles), SFTP access, DNS→HTTPS stepper, and App credentials.

## Credentials de-dupe logic
Group install tasks by resolved target site key (`primary` / `subdomain:<id>` / `addon:<id>`); since tasks are fetched newest-first, the first seen per key wins; each row carries its resolved `site` hostname. `AppCredentials.tsx` now shows the hostname beside the app name.

## Domains vs Websites division
Websites is now the sole management hub (install / open files / set-primary / delete). The Domains tab is **add-only**: an "Add domains & DNS" intro card + the subdomain/addon add forms with DNS help. `SubdomainsPanel`/`AddonDomainsPanel` got a `manageOnlyInWebsites` prop that hides the per-row Delete (replaced with a "Manage in Websites" hint) — removing the overlap.

## Settings
Added a **Plan name** rename card (`RenameCard`) at the top of Settings. Left the existing `PlanUpgrade` block untouched.

## Shared-file edits (for clean integration)
- `prisma/schema.prisma` (new `name` field)
- `lib/actions-hosting.ts` (rename action, view fields, credentials rewrite, new log action, `friendlyPlanName`)
- `HostingTabs.tsx`, `HostingClient.tsx`, `app/dashboard/hosting/[id]/page.tsx` (header/switcher/tab wiring)
- `WebsitesPanel.tsx`, `AppCredentials.tsx`, `SubdomainsPanel.tsx`, `AddonDomainsPanel.tsx`

## Coupling notes for the other agents
- **EmailTab.tsx was not touched** (per instructions). The email tab still renders unchanged.
- **Settings/upgrade agent**: I only added a rename card at the top of `SettingsTab`; the existing `PlanUpgrade` block under the "Plan" card is left in place. If that agent rewrites the Plan/storage section, expect a small merge around the SettingsTab function in `HostingTabs.tsx` — the rename card is a self-contained `RenameCard` component that can move freely.
- **`HostingAccountView`** gained two fields (`name`, `displayName`) — any agent constructing this view via `toView` gets them for free; anyone hand-building the view object will need to add them.
- **prisma client is symlinked** to `/opt/nxeon-wt-mktg/node_modules` (a sibling worktree, not prod). `prisma generate` regenerated the shared client from the `agent/ia` schema; if the mktg worktree's schema diverges, whoever generates last wins — worth a regenerate there after merge.
- Dead-but-exported `GettingStarted`/`TaskFeed` remain in `shared.tsx` (no longer imported anywhere); left in place to avoid breaking any parallel branch that might import them — safe to prune at merge time.
